I am 74, and my land is only 5 mu, so I will keep my plan simple and manageable. Because some people in my family work off-farm, I cannot rely on a lot of labor at busy times. I also have well irrigation, so I will use that to keep the crops stable if rainfall is uneven. I grow cotton and maize, and this year I will still plant both, but I will put a little more land into maize because it is simpler for me to manage and gives steady grain for the household and cash. I will keep cotton on a smaller area because it needs more watching and more spraying, but it still brings income, so I will not give it up. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps me get a steadier stand and better yield. I will use moderate fertilizer, not too little and not too much, because I want reliable growth without wasting money. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier for me to arrange on a small farm than deep ploughing. I will irrigate a few times from the well when the crop most needs water, and I will spray when pests become a problem, especially in cotton. My main goal this year is stable output, less labor pressure, and lower risk.
